name: Pure in Heart
source:
Pure in Heart is a courtly romance otome visual novel. You play as the human daughter of a duke entering a royal court full of dragons. While the Red Queen's Summer Court prepares for a season of feasting, dancing, hunting, jousting, and other festivities, our heroine finds herself surrounded by familiar friends and eligible bachelors vying for her hand in marriage. But is it true love or is it just a matter of politics?

[From [url=https://goddess-of-gales.itch.io/pure-in-heart]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《赤子之心》是一部宫廷言情乙女视觉小说。你扮演一位公爵的人类女儿，进入充满龙的皇家宫廷。当红皇后的夏季宫廷准备迎接盛宴、舞蹈、狩猎、比武和其他庆祝活动时，我们的女主人公发现自己周围都是熟悉的朋友和合格的单身汉，他们在争夺她的婚姻。但这是真爱还是只是政治问题？

[来自[url=https://goddess-of-gales.itch.io/pure-in-heart]Itch.io[/url]]
